slides.title: Who are you *still trying to be?*
slides.sub: Some of the pressure you carry comes from an old version of you.

slides.title: Name the old version
slides.body: Finish this: "I'm supposed to be the one who..." The one who never needs help. The one who has it all figured out.

slides.title: Ask where it came from
slides.body: When did that version make sense? Who were you then, and what was it protecting you from?

slides.title: Check if it still fits
slides.body: Does living up to it help the life you have now? Or does it mostly leave you feeling behind?

slides.title: Keep one part. Set one down.
slides.body: Keep what still serves you. Then write one sentence: "I don't have to be ___ anymore."
